body:
Source: GitHub issue #701 (bug, tokenomics, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ 16ba5fa8: packages/model-router/bin/model-router.mjs:74-87. `runRouter` returns `{ assignments, p3Findings, skippedLedger }`. In table mode, if `skippedLedger.length > 0`, it prints `Warning: N malformed ledger line(s) skipped.` to stderr. In `--json` mode, it emits `{ assignments, p3Findings }` on stdout with no mention of `skippedLedger`, and emits no warning to stderr, hiding corrupted ledger data from orchestrators.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/model-router`: `bin/model-router.mjs` (CLI entry point), `lib/router.mjs` (runRouter), `lib/priors.mjs`, `lib/assign.mjs`, `lib/density.mjs`. Tests: `npm test -w packages/model-router` from the worktree root.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `bin/model-router.mjs`: In `--json` mode (`values.json`), include `skippedLedger` (array of skipped lines, or `skippedLedgerCount: skippedLedger.length` alongside `skippedLedger`) in the emitted JSON object on stdout.
2. In both table mode AND `--json` mode, when `skippedLedger.length > 0`, emit `Warning: ${skippedLedger.length} malformed ledger line(s) skipped.` to stderr.
3. Documentation: update `packages/model-router/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `docs/tools/model-router.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/model-router.mdx` (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `model-router --json` with malformed ledger lines surfaces `skippedLedger` in the JSON payload. verify: `node --test packages/model-router/test/skipped-ledger-json.test.mjs`
- AC2 `model-router --json` with malformed ledger lines prints the warning to stderr. verify: `node --test packages/model-router/test/skipped-ledger-json.test.mjs`
- AC3 Existing test suite passes with no regressions. verify: `npm test -w packages/model-router`
- AC4 Docs updated in all three mirror files. verify: `grep -c "skippedLedger" packages/model-router/README.md docs/tools/model-router.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/model-router.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC5 Mutation gate green on branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12`

OUT OF SCOPE: Issue #702 (signature validation of priors) or #703 (manifest priors source description).
title: model-router: include skippedLedger in --json output and keep stderr warning
